name: cc-preview
description: Preview images and markdown files from the conversation and the prompt: hover cards, and a side pane to browse them

pictures.title: Pictures
pictures.description: How pictures are drawn. graphics: kitty graphics (kitty, Ghostty, WezTerm). blocks: colored block characters, which every terminal and mosh carry. auto: graphics only where they are known to reach the screen (no mosh on the way, a terminal that draws them), else blocks; looked at again every 5 s.

language.title: Language
language.description: UI language. auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then LC_ALL / LANG, else English.
